result.title: UltraData-Code: From Raw Repositories to Algorithmically Dense and Task-Oriented Code Data
result.summary: Code generation has become a core capability of large language models (LLMs), and code data is central to the pre-training process that develops it. As obtaining public code of sufficient quality becomes more difficult, further progress cannot rely on corpus expansion alone. Tiered data management instead applies increasingly targeted processing to smaller data pools, producing data states suited to different training objectives. Following this perspective, we present UltraData-Code as four connected data states spanning repository archival at L0, standardized natural code at L1, algorithmic selection at L2, and task-oriented synthesis at L3. L0 preserves repository data and provenance for reprocessing, while L1 applies scalable filtering, normalization, and near-deduplication for broad pre-training. L2 selects high-quality algorithmically relevant files using language-adaptive relevance signals and quality constraints, yielding approximately 400B tokens of UltraData-Code-L2 across 11 programming languages for focused continual pre-training. L3 converts selected implementations into structured programming exercises, yielding approximately 150B tokens of UltraData-Code-L3 across the same 11 languages for task-oriented mid-training or supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Under controlled 10B-token continual pre-training of a 1B model, L2 improves pass@1 over L1 by 7.80 percentage points (pp) on EvalPlus and 5.13pp on MultiPL-E. Replacing half of the L2 training tokens with L3 yields a further gain of 8.42pp and 8.07pp on the two benchmarks, respectively. Both gains increase when the training budget scales to 100B tokens. We have released our datasets and classifiers to support further research on LLMs.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文构建 UltraData-Code 代码数据体系，将原始仓库数据分为 L0–L3 四个层级的数据状态，逐级进行过滤规范化、算法相关性筛选与任务化题目合成，并在小规模持续预训练中验证其代码生成收益。
